title: mentha × villosa var. cordifolia
intro: Mentha × villosa var. cordifolia, commonly known as heartleaf mint, is a variety of peppermint that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used for centuries for its medicinal properties, providing relief from digestive issues, nausea, and headaches due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of heartleaf mint include its ability to stimulate digestion, calm the nervous system, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in heartleaf mint include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
